column2: .) Origin of data Migration statistics is compiled by Statistics Austria and is based on the data (registrations and deregistrations) of the ZMR (central register of residents). International migration (in- and out-migration) are cross-border changes of residence. The duration of residence must not be shorter than 90 days (effective registration of main residence) i.e., migration statistics covers in- and out- migration of persons only who have their main residence registered in Austria for 90 days, at least. For further information please see Other Metadata: https://www.statistik.at/en/statistics/population-and-society/population/migration-and-naturalisation .) Legal foundations Migration statistics is a statutory statistics according to article 4(1) Federal Statistics Law. The transfer of the register data required for migration statistics is regulated by article 16b(6) of the registration law. .)
